phone.speaker: nii
phone.text: An old phone from our room? Before my time, chale. But I know how it works: end of the year the caretaker clears the rooms, and anything worth money goes down to the Porter's Lodge. Lost property.

choices.text: Did you know the guy who had our room before?

kojo.speaker: nii
kojo.text: Only the name. Kojo. People go quiet when it comes up, so I stopped asking.

welcome.speaker: nii
welcome.text: Anytime. If it's dead when you find it, bring it here — I can charge anything.
